body.statement: For the balanced \(n=N_n=8\), \(M=2\), \(G_n=4\), \(G_{1n}=2\) witness, \(V_{1,n}=E_{\tau,1,n}=3/7\), \(C_{11,n}=-1/7\), \(\sigma_n^2=1/7\), and \(\mathbb E[\widehat V_{\mathrm{CR2},n}]=2/7\). Exhaustive enumeration over the \(105\) perfect matchings and the \(6\) balanced treatment allocations, totaling \(630\) design points, reproduces both moments.
body.justification: A fully enumerable dense design fixes the sign, normalization, and magnitude of the projection correction.
body.gap: No cited random-group inference result reports this finite dense witness or the factor-two CR2 excess.
body.consumer: The witness is a regression test for symbolic derivations and for a design-aware \({\tt vcovCR}\) diagnostic.
